study: Broadbalk historical wheat: observed-weather temporal transfer
exposure: Schemas, field metadata, management factors and weather layout inspected; numerical yield outcomes not inspected or scored before this plan. Hoosfield published aggregate means have been seen and are not untouched data.

site.scope: One English site; temporal test with the same physical plot in both periods. Not spatially independent or a global/AD200 validation.

split.group: Whole harvest years, all treatments together; repeated plot across time is intentional and disclosed.

primary.units: Harvested grain t/ha/year at field moisture (approximately 85% dry matter, not measured). No seed, edible fraction or kcal deductions from observations.
primary.area: Use supplied hectares to aggregate subplots within plot/year; reject duplicate year/plot/subplot. Grain already per hectare; never divide it by area.

diagnostics.management: FYM-only requires FYM present and all other factors nil. 35t FYM/ha/year is intensive organic, not generic ancient low input. Mineral-only requires no FYM/rape cake and at least one non-nil mineral. Other strata never enter selection.
diagnostics.calendar: Count inclusive sow-to-harvest calendar months using observed dates. Check existing 4–9 month length, every-month 3–24 C, warmest >=12 C, heat >=1500 at 365/12 days/month. Outside-window months flag unrepresentable seasons. Calendar audit is structural, not a refit or a daily phenology model.

weather.temperature: Tmean sheet Mean Temperature (Mean), Jan–Dec columns19–30; mean daily Tmax/Tmin from Tmax Mean columns19–30 and Tmin Mean columns20–31. Do not use monthly extreme maxima/minima.
weather.rain: DATA Jan–Dec columns2–13; mm. Historical 1880–1914 RAIN5 substitution retained as documented. Gaps in daily rain counts retained and flagged: provider says many are traces <0.05mm, not proved exclusively trace.
weather.quality: Exclude crop-years with missing/nonfinite monthly weather, negative rain/DTR or incomplete temperature daily counts. Keep finite observed monthly rain totals despite missing daily counts; report counts and 0.05mm*missing-days as a trace-only sensitivity bound, not a guaranteed error bound.
weather.pet: Existing Hargreaves + sunlight_top; Earth tilt23.44, solstice355; mean monthly bins 365/12 days retained. Not station-observed ET.
weather.soil: 100mm reference bucket, half-full January1878; chronological monthly P minus reference PET with capacity clipping. Not root-specific crop water accounting.
weather.crop_year: September of previous calendar year through August of harvest year. No cyclic wrap; candidate windows must end within this 12-month series. Fixed crop-year is an environmental-capacity diagnostic, not observed sowing management or a prospective forecast.

model.baseline: Existing crop_windows wheat response, rainfed, no dry/cold reliability factors; chronological observed weather and soil states, nonwrapping 4–9 month windows. Max energy converted back to gross grain with identical crop edible*kcal*(1-seed)*1000, hence 1t/ha baseline ceiling. No wheat response coefficient fitted.
model.candidate: One shared grain-yield multiplier only. Does not repair nutrients, waterlogging, frost, weeds or winter dormancy.
model.objective: Mean absolute log10 error, both observed/predicted floored at0.05t/ha. Equal primary-year weights; deterministic minimum over complete grid; tie closest to1 then smaller. Global optimum only over this finite one-dimensional candidate set.
model.comparator: Training arithmetic mean unmanured yield, constant across evaluation years. Not fitted on test outcomes.

eligibility.yield_observation: Exclude missing, negative or nonfinite grain; retain zero with0.05 log floor. Require positive finite area, valid ISO sow/harvest dates with sow<harvest and harvest year matching record. Do not remove weather extremes, changing cultivar or poor-yield years.
eligibility.identity: Canonical numeric plot IDs; unique year/plot/subplot; all records in a year share fold; each primary year produces exactly one aggregate. Reject conflicting dates/cultivars inside any primary year.

qualification.temporal_comparator: At least20 train and20 evaluation primary years; candidate test log MAE <=0.95 baseline; positive RMSE skill against training mean and positive Pearson correlation. All conditions required. Not ancient adoption.
qualification.reason: One continuously cropped, nutrient-depleted trial site cannot identify global AD200 yield or nutrient management. No population/control/production atlas defaults changed.

integrity: Commit exact source manifest and plan before preparation/selection. Commit selection, producer code and identities before evaluation. Raw historical data downloadable; evaluated pool becomes spent. Woburn yields reserved/unscored pending matching local weather; Rothamsted weather never silently substituted at Woburn. Reserved climate f untouched.
